definitions.explanation: An extremely brief period of time.
Used adverbially to describe something happening very briefly.

examples.japanese: {一瞬|いっしゅん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
{一瞬|いっしゅん}⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}した→離す：19372_hanasu⟧⟦{隙|すき}→隙：10999_suki_gap⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: In the instant I looked away.

examples.japanese: {一瞬|いっしゅん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The scenery changed in an instant.

examples.japanese: {一瞬|いっしゅん}、⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}からなかった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: For an instant, I didn't understand what happened.

examples.japanese: {一瞬|いっしゅん}⟦{迷|まよ}った→迷う：02426_mayou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦すぐに→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: I hesitated for a moment, but decided right away.

examples.japanese: {一瞬|いっしゅん}⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦すぐに→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{人込|ひとご}み→人込み：03709_hitogomi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{消|き}えた→消える：02520_kieru⟧。
examples.english: I caught a glimpse of his face for an instant, but he quickly disappeared into the crowd.

notes:
{一瞬|いっしゅん} means an extremely brief moment — a split second. It can function as both a noun and an adverb.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一瞬|いっしゅん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: a momentary ~ ({一瞬|いっしゅん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧: a momentary event)
- {一瞬|いっしゅん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in an instant
- {一瞬|いっしゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧: in a flash (slightly literary)
- ⟦ほんの→ほんの：22755_honno⟧{一瞬|いっしゅん}: just an instant

ADVERBIAL USAGE:
When used adverbially, it often appears at the beginning of a sentence: {一瞬|いっしゅん}、⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}からなかった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ (For an instant, I didn't know what happened).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧: moment, instant (often interchangeable, but ⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧ can also mean "the moment when")
- ⟦{一刻|いっこく}→一刻：08924_ikkoku⟧: a moment (literary, often used with ⟦{一刻|いっこく}→一刻：08924_ikkoku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧ — as soon as possible)

FORMS:
{一|いっ} (one) + {瞬|しゅん} (blink). Literally "one blink of an eye."

cross_references.label: a moment, a while, a brief time
